How Acme Widgets Reduced Assembly Time by 40%

Manufacturing teams have long struggled with the manual overhead of widget assembly. In this article we walk through the three changes that had the biggest measurable impact on throughput at three of our enterprise customers over the last two quarters.

1. Batch pre-staging

Rather than pulling components one at a time, staging a full batch ahead of the shift start reduced walk time by roughly eighteen percent across every site we measured.

2. Torque-guided fastening

Standardizing on torque-guided tools removed an entire manual QA pass from the line, cutting per-unit assembly time by a further twelve percent.

3. Real-time defect flagging

Surfacing defects to the line operator immediately, instead of at end-of-shift review, cut rework time dramatically and was the single largest contributor to the 40% figure.
